action.objective: Verify b6b7 as the reserved leading candidate before committing.
action.rationale: Broad depth-4 search favors b6b7 (exact -470, only exact row, mates avoided) and scores a7b7/a7a6 merely as upper bounds. Reserve is assigned to b6b7. Single-candidate verification will check mate safety and clarify the knight-free rook endgame.
